description: Adds user-requested free-form feedback to the Cactal product-feedback inbox. Describe what happened and what would have made the experience better. Agents must set `authorKind` to `agent` even when acting through a user OAuth connection. Never include credentials, secrets, raw sensitive user content, or unnecessary personal or customer data.

authorKind.description: Who wrote the feedback. An AI agent must pass "agent" even when connected through a user OAuth token.

feedback.description: Concise free-form feedback describing the Cactal problem or limitation and what would have made the experience better.

name: feedback_submit
title: Submit product feedback
